Wow, there's nobody here!\nIt's like we've got the whole beach to ourselves!\nHow fancy~!
Compared to Saltau's Beach, the sand here is nicer\nand feels good! You think it's gonna be fun to\nswim...?
So...you like the beach?
Huh?\nWho are you?
How about cowrals...? Do you like them?
What? Cowrals?\nDo you mean...corals?!
You know where they grow?!
Uh-huh, I know...You like them?
What? You don't know what corals are?! Treasure\nchests have always been known to hold gold coins,\njewels, and coral! That's the standard!
Corals found in deep waters are particularly\nbeautiful and highly valuable!
Oh...
Uh, sorry, I'll see you again next time!
What? Wait a minute!\nI won’t let you go until you tell me where\nthe corals are!
Uh, I'll tell you next time!
Nope! You're not getting away from me!
Ah! Oh, no! This is bad!
Aaah!
Hey, what happened to you?!
Oh...you caught me...
Wait, so you're a shark-human?!
Uh...yes. I can only turn into a human for a few\nminutes.
I can also change forms anytime. I don't have to\nwait.
I'm surprised.\nNo wonder you know so much about corals.
My name is Akula...\nI wanted to have human friends, so I used my power\nto turn into one.
That's confusing and doesn't really explain\nanything, you know? And when you say human\nfriends, you mean...Oh!
You think I'd make a great friend just because\nI'm small, right?
Uh...You don't think so?
Show some respect, will ya~? Believe it or not,\nI'm a lot older than you. I'm your big sis, you\nknow!
...Really?
Hmm, I guess it's not easy for a shark to make\nfriends with humans. I mean, nobody wants to get\neaten~.
I'd never eat my frenz!\nI just wanna be frenzs with everyone!
Looks like she really wants human friends. Welp,\nsince we need to find the corals too, I guess we\ncan't just sit back and do nothing, right?
I think we should play the bad guys here.\nWe'll pick a fight with someone Akula wanna be\nfriends with and put on a show...
No, don't do that!\nWe shouldn't pick fights with our frenz!
I don't think you understand...
Well, just leave it to us! First, we need a\nmakeover! Pure-hearted people like us need some\nserious prep to look like bad guys!
Hey, Akula, do you know where we can get some\nscary-looking stuff around here?
Scarrie-looking stuff?
Do you think piyate is scarrie?
Piyates?\nAh, you mean pirates.\nNot bad, we might be able to find some skeletons.
Uh...there's a scarrie piyates' hideout if you\nhead south.
Okay!\nYou wait here!\nWe'll go get ready!
We've walked quite far.\nNo one's here.
Our goal is to explore the pirates' hideout.
They say it's on the south side of this island.\nI heard even adults don't go near it these days.\nIt's a bit scary, but I'm excited.
Uh, I know where it is!\nI can show you the way if you want!
They say there's pirate treasure there.\nDo you think it's true?
Yeah, that's the rumor, but they say there's\nprobably nothing valuable left.
Treasure?\nMaybe cowrals? I wonder if they like cowrals.
Let's just go now!
Yeah, let's go!
Oh...
Akula~!\nWe've brought a bunch of stuff~!
Huh?\nYou look gloomy, what's wrong?
It's...nothing. Don't worry about it.
So, I was thinking about how we should disguise\nourselves~. Actually, I think we should wear a\nskull.
We should wrap ourselves in a skull flag too,\nthen let out a creepy laugh like "Bwahaha!"\nWhat do you think? Pretty scary, right?
You won't make any frenz that way.\nHow about cowral? You'll be able to make friends\nif you wrap yourself in cowral.
You seriously think everyone will be thrilled if\nyou show up with coral? Who told you so?
Uh...Oh!
My frenz are crying...\nThey must have been attacked by pirates.\nThey're in danger!
Pirates? Friends? I'm actually impressed you could\nhear that. Do shark-humans have really good\nhearing? Besides, I didn't know you had friends.
Well, we're not exactly friends, but we're\nfriends!!
I don't really get it, but this definitely isn't\nthe time to be disguising ourselves!
Alright, Akula! Let's go check on your friends!
Wheeeeee!!!
Oh...\nLook who's back with us!
Uh...where am I?
You were injured.\nWe escaped from that pirate ship and quickly\nbrought you here.
Oh, thanks...
Oh, no! I'm still in shark form!
So, uh...
Hey, wait!\nDon't go, it's okay!
Actually, we've seen it before.\nYou got that wound from that pirate, didn't you?\nBesides...
Actually, we've known about you for a while.\nWhen we found out you were a shark, we freaked out\nand pretended not to know. We're so sorry...
But now we know we were wrong!\nWe'll never be scared of you again!\nStarting today, we're friends!
I have so much to tell you!!
Hmm, she hasn't said anything about the corals\nyet, but I'm not gonna be that person and ruin the\nmoment.
Well, we're definitely gonna get those corals\nsomeday anyway, right?!

Ah, what a beautiful day~!\nIt's the perfect day to go for a dip in the ocean!
Besides, there's no one on the beach either!\nSo the moment anyone pops into view, we'll spot\nthem right away...
Huh?\nDid I just see something pop up?
Oh, it's you, Akula!\nWhat are you doing over there? Come here!
So...you like the beach?
...You asked me the exact same thing last time.\nAre you really trying to take us back to the\nbeginning of our friendship?
It's me! Pelulu!\nHow dare you forget this charming baby face of\nmine?!
Oh, it's you guysh!\nNow I remember! Long time no shee!
So, how is it going?\nDon't tell me you're still on your friend-hunting\nmission.
Uh, I've made two frenz since then!
What?! Really?! That's great!!\nWho?! And where are they now?!
Uh...Pelulu and you!
What the...that's such a letdown~!
So basically, you haven't made any new friends\nsince then.\nThat's kinda sad~...
Uh, I've got my pamily, so it's otay!
Pamily?\nOh~, you mean family.
Uh, I want you to come visit my house!\nI wanna introduce you to my pamily!
Hmm...I wonder what Akula's family is like.\nAren't you curious too?
C'mon! This way!
Poppa! Poppa!\nUh, we have guests!
Oh, Akula, there you are!\nIt's way past snack time!
Poppa!\nUh, they're the frenz I told you about before!
I made you a sea anemone pie!\nEat it while it's still warm!
Hmm~, so he's Akula's father.\nHe looks like a kind shark-human!
Hello, it's a pleasure to meet you, sir!
Oh, right! I made some sea parsley jam too!\nIt goes best with the pie!
Hello? Excuse me, sir?
Hahaha! Sea parsley jam comes in six levels of\nsweetness! You always preferred the sweeter ones,\ndidn't you, Akula?
Hey, don't ignore me! I'm trying to say hello!
W-w-who are you?!\nWhen did you get here!?
Seriously?!\nWe literally came here with Akula a second ago!!
Poppa!\nThey're the frenz I told you about before!
What? Your friends?!
My name is Aba...\nI'm an intelligent man with a pure heart, and\nI am Akula's father.
So, who are you guys?\nWhat exactly is a friend?\nDo you guys hang out together and eat together?
Well, it's been a while since we last came here to\nhang out with her, right?
Do you guys read the same books, talk about them\ntogether, coo over cute animals, and even make\nplans to visit a faraway town together?!
Y-You guys are planning to go on a long journey\nwithout me!?\nGrrr...Unforgivable!!!
Whoa!\nYou almost gave me a heart attack! What's wrong\nwith you?!
Listen! From now on, whenever you wanna go near my\ndaughter, make sure you let me know first!
What's this old man's problem...?\nMaybe he's one of the reasons Akula can't make\nany friends.
Poppa!\nI wanna treat Pelulu and this adventurer here to\na nice meal!
Hmph! You want me to feed these guys too?!\nThere aren't enough ingredients here! I'll have to\nmake a trip to the pantry...
Oh, wait...There's no way something as trivial as\nfriendship could ever beat the bond between a\nfather and a daughter.
Yeah! Maybe now's the perfect time to show them\nthe strength of our bond and knock them down a peg\nor two!
Sorry, Akula.\nI think I need a little more time to get the food\nready.
Really?
While waiting, why don't you take your friends to\nour "Ocean Pantry" and show them the treasure\nyou're so proud of?
Hold on, did you just say "treasure"?\nThat's not something I can just ignore!\nThat's my favorite thing in the world, you know!!
Alright then!\nThe "Ocean Pantry" is basically a storehouse on\nthe ocean floor. Now, put these on!
Huh? What are these?
They're small "Bubble Shells".\nPut them in your nostrils, and you'll be able to\nbreathe underwater.
Oh~, thanks~! Putting something in my nose isn't\nexactly ladylike, but for treasure, that's a tiny\nprice to pay!
Okay, let's go!\nTake us to where the treasure is!
Whee! Pelulu, you're all pumped up!\nC'mon, this way!
Mwahaha! Foolish brats!\nI'll show you just how terrifying the bond between\na father and his daughter can be!
Talk to Pelulu to set out for the [ffff64]Ocean Pantry[ffffff].
